data.title: 加藤惠 · 赶工后的便利店热饮
data.description: 游戏制作告一段落，惠穿鼠尾草绿连帽外套和深蓝牛仔裤坐在便利店长椅上，把热饮捧在两掌之间。纸袋里的饭团还未拆开，她侧头望向街灯，疲惫的棕眼中浮出很浅的笑。
data.action: 双手捧着热饮坐在长椅上，侧头露出疲惫的浅笑。
data.promptProse: Megumi Kato rests on the convenience-store bench after game work, holding a hot drink between both palms. Her sage-green hoodie and navy jeans remain relaxed above canvas sneakers; unopened rice balls stay inside the paper bag beside her. She turns toward the streetlamp with a small tired smile. In the medium portrait, soft shopfront light brightens her brown bob and cup, leaving the bench underside and street beyond more subdued.
